* **Default Damage Track.** For Power Sets with a repeated attack pattern, the baseline formula for unarmed strikes or attacks from this Power Set.  
* **Core Track.** The four Core Track steps in order, each a passive benefit defining scale and unlocking higher-Tier power access.  
* **Combat Powers.** All At-Will, Encounter, Daily, and Reaction powers that affect combat.  
* **Set-Specific Utility Powers.** All noncombat, movement, sensory, survival, and support powers tied to this Power Set.  
* **Enhancements.** Common Enhancements appropriate to this Power Set with their specific effects.  
* **Limitations.** Common Limitations players often pair with this Power Set and what each restricts.

A Note on Scale

#### Three Tiers, One Power Set

The Power Sets in Chapter 11 cover all three Campaign Ranks. Every Power Set has entries for all three Tiers. A Street Level campaign uses only Tier 1 powers from each set. A Mid-Level campaign uses up to Tier 2\. A World Class campaign uses all three Tiers including Apex powers.

This means a hero who begins play at Street Level and whose campaign eventually elevates to World Class can continue developing the same Power Set across the full ten levels. The hero who began throwing small fireballs at Tier 1 is eventually hurling citywide firestorms at Tier 3\. That progression is the point.

# **Chapter Eleven · Power Sets**

Power Sets

Every Power Set entry covers: Governing Ability, Core Track, Combat Powers, Utility Powers, Enhancements, and Limitations.

How to Read Attack and Damage Lines

Every Combat Power in this chapter prints its attack line in full: **1d20 \+ delivery modifier \+ Governing Ability modifier \+ Prowess**. The delivery modifier is set by how the attack reaches its target — **FIG** for melee, **DEX** for ranged, **INT** for mental, **CHA** for social. The Governing Ability modifier is the one named at the top of that Power Set's entry.

Damage adds two modifiers as well: the **Governing Ability modifier** of the Power Set, and the **damage modifier** for the delivery method — **STR** for melee, **DEX** for ranged, **INT** for mental, **CHA** for social. Melee is the only delivery method that uses different abilities for the attack roll and the damage roll: Fighting lands the blow, Strength is the force behind it.

Where a Power's Governing Ability is the same as its delivery modifier, that ability is added **twice**. This is intended. → Chapter 10: Power Attack Roll vs. Effect Value


This chapter presents all Power Sets available in HEROIC 5e. A named power always deals at least its Power Set's Default Damage, so a higher-Tier power never falls behind an At-Will as the Core Track rises. Each entry follows the standard format established in Chapter 10: Governing Ability, Associated Conditions, Default Damage Track, Core Track, Combat Powers, Set-Specific Utility Powers, Enhancements, and Limitations. Read Chapter 10's framework section before using these entries — it explains the language, the Power Pick economy, and what every mechanical term means.

How to Read a Power Entry

Each power entry shows: **Name** · **Tier and Type** (e.g. Tier 1 At-Will) · **Action Cost**. Prerequisite is shown in italics. Range, attack, effects, and condition durations follow. The default condition duration is until the end of the attacker's next Turn unless stated otherwise.

Power type is colour-coded: At-Will · Encounter · Daily · Utility · Passive · Sustained. Reaction is an action cost rather than a power type, and appears in the entry line

### Air Control

| Governing Ability | Choose DEX, WIS, or CHA when you first acquire this Power Set |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Associated Conditions** | Prone (via gust and downdraft), Slowed (via headwind and pressure), Shaken (via deafening roar), Restrained (via compressed-air vice) |
| **Default Damage** | Power Dice × Core Track level \+ Governing Ability modifier \+ damage modifier (STR melee, DEX ranged, INT mental, CHA social) |
| **Tactical Role** | Mobility, displacement, and battlefield repositioning; lighter on raw damage, unmatched at moving friend and foe around the field |

Air Control is the Power Set of wind, pressure, and the invisible ocean everyone lives at the bottom of. Not the storm — that is Weather Control's domain — but the air itself: the ability to gust, lift, compress, and redirect moving air with precision, to ride the currents, to snatch the breath from an enemy's lungs or carry an ally clear of danger on a sudden updraft. Air controllers are the most mobile combatants in the game and the finest at controlling the geometry of a fight without ever laying a hand on anyone. They scatter formations, drag enemies off ledges, hold projectiles in mid-flight, and turn open ground into a battlefield they alone can navigate cleanly. What they lack in brute lethality they make up for in reach, control, and the simple fact that the wind is everywhere and never runs out.

#### Governing Ability

Choose **DEX, WIS, or CHA** when you first acquire this Power Set.

**DEX** — precise, reactive control of currents, pressure, and motion, shaping the air through reflex, coordination, and constant adjustment.

**WIS** — intuitive or mystical attunement to the atmosphere, feeling shifts in pressure and movement as naturally as changes in balance or breath.

**CHA** — commanding authority projected into the element, the wind responding directly to confidence, emotion, and force of will.

#### Core Track

Air Control 1  
*Tier 1 Passive*

Summon, shape, and direct moving air within range. Slow your own falls to a drift, ignoring fall damage. Gain a hovering drift of 10 ft and Advantage on saves against forced movement that would push or pull you. Tier 1 access.

Air Control 2  
*Tier 2 Passive*

Combat-scale wind shaping. Gain a Flying Speed equal to your full Speed; you are a competent flier in open air. You have Advantage on Active Defense rolls against ranged attacks from non-superpowered sources, as crosswinds foul their aim. Tier 2 access.

Air Control 3  
*Tier 3 Passive*

Range extends to Long (121–300 ft). Once per encounter as a free action, fill a Zone within range with churning, buffeting wind: the area is difficult terrain for enemies and all ranged attacks passing into or through it are made at Disadvantage. Your Flying Speed increases to twice your full Speed. Tier 3 access.

Air Control 4  
*Tier 3 Apex Passive*

Once per day, enter **Living Cyclone** for 1 minute: you become a being of wind and pressure, gaining immunity to all physical damage from non-superpowered sources as attacks pass through your diffuse form; you may move through any opening air can pass through; any creature that begins its Turn within Close range (25 ft) Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: the target is pushed Close range and knocked Prone; and all air attacks deal maximum damage on the dice.

#### Combat Powers

**Air Blast** — Tier 1 · At-Will · Action

*Prerequisite: Air Control 1*

A compressed fist of moving air, thrown the way someone else would throw a punch. It is the workhorse of the set — no set-up, no resource spent, effective at a distance where most fighters cannot reach. Landing it well puts the target on the back foot as much as it hurts them.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: Default damage track (bludgeoning). Strong Success: push Close range (25 ft) from you.

**Updraft** — Tier 1 · At-Will · Action

*Prerequisite: Air Control 1*

Seize one creature or loose object within range on a column of rising air. The target is torn off its footing and carried wherever you steer the current — up over a barricade, out across a gap, or off the edge of a roof entirely. Nothing about the ride guarantees a gentle landing at the other end.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: The target is lifted and moved up to Close range (25 ft) in any direction, including upward. If dropped from height, it takes falling damage as normal. Strong Success: the target is also knocked Prone on landing.

**Wind Wall** — Tier 1 · Encounter · Bonus Action

*Prerequisite: Air Control 1*

Raise a curtain of howling wind. Until start of your next Turn, you and allies within Close range (25 ft) have Advantage on Active Defense rolls against ranged attacks, and any creature attempting to move through the wall toward you Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: the target is Slowed until end of its next Turn.

**Cyclone Spin** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Air Control 2*

Spin on the spot and drag the air around with you until it becomes a wall of wind travelling outward in every direction. This is what you use when they have closed the distance and surrounded you — it clears the space you are standing in without asking you to choose which of them to deal with first.

* Range: Close area (15-ft radius, 0–25 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of each creature  
* Hit: 2 Power Dice bludgeoning damage. Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: pushed Close range (25 ft) from you \+ knocked Prone; Success: pushed Close range only.

**Compress** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Air Control 2*

Crush the air around a single target into a vice of pressure. The atmosphere itself closes on them from every side at once, pinning arms to ribs and squeezing the breath out before they can set their feet. There is nothing to brace against and nothing to push away — the thing holding them is the air they were already standing in.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: 2 Power Dice bludgeoning damage. Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: Restrained as the pressure pins them in place; Success: Slowed only (both until end of your next Turn).

**Gale Force** — Tier 3 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Air Control 3*

Put your shoulder behind a wind that would strip tiles off a roof and aim it down a street. Everything in the cone goes backwards: people, furniture, anything not bolted down. Aimed well, it does not merely hurt a formation — it takes the formation apart and scatters it somewhere less convenient.

* Range: Medium area (30-ft cone within 50–120 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of each creature  
* Hit: 3 Power Dice bludgeoning damage. Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: pushed Medium range (50 ft) from you \+ knocked Prone; Success: pushed Close range only. Loose objects and unsecured creatures in the cone are scattered.

**Vacuum Collapse** — Tier 3 · Daily · Action

*Prerequisite: Air Control 3*

Tear the air out of a space, then let it slam back in. For a heartbeat there is nothing where your target was standing — no sound, no breath, no pressure — and then the surrounding atmosphere collapses into the void all at once. The damage comes from the return, not the removal, and anyone caught in it is left with nothing to breathe.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: 6 Power Dice bludgeoning damage, maximum on all dice. Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: cannot breathe and is Stunned until end of your next Turn \+ Slowed for the remainder of the encounter; Success: Stunned until end of your next Turn only.

**Cushion** — Tier 3 · Encounter · Reaction

*Prerequisite: Air Control 3 · Trigger: You or one ally within Short range (26–50 ft) would take falling, bludgeoning, or forced-movement damage*

Catch the impact on a cushion of compressed air. Reduce incoming damage by 3 Power Dice \+ Governing Ability modifier. If this brings the damage to 0, the protected creature may immediately drift up to Close range (25 ft) to safety as the air sets them down clear.

#### Set-Specific Utility Powers

**Air Shape** — Tier 1 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Air Control 1*

Hold a current of air in a simple sustained form: a lifting platform, a bridge of compressed wind, a screen that muffles sound, or a steady draft. Holds for one scene or until dismissed. Cannot be shaped into a weapon or used to deal damage.

**Carry the Voice** — Tier 1 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Air Control 1*

Direct moving air to carry a whisper to a specific ear within Long range (121–300 ft), or to scatter your voice so its source cannot be located. Can also amplify your voice to carry clearly across a crowd or a battlefield.

**Soaring** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Air Control 2*

Ride the high currents to travel long distances at speed. Outside combat, cross regional distances within hours on winds you summon ahead of yourself. Does not stack with the Flight Power Set — use whichever speed is higher.

**Air Sense** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Air Control 2*

Read the movement of air within Short range (26–50 ft) without a check: detect hidden creatures by the way they disturb the currents, sense open spaces and passages behind walls, and feel changes in pressure that precede movement. Functions in total darkness.

**Becalm** — Tier 3 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Air Control 3*

As an Action, still all natural air movement within Medium range (51–120 ft): smother flames that depend on air, clear smoke, gas, spores, or other airborne effects from the area, and create a pocket of breathable, silent calm. Persists while you concentrate.

#### Enhancements

* **Driving Gust:** Air Blast's push distance increases to Medium range (51–120 ft); the target also Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: the target is knocked Prone.  
* **Held Aloft:** Updraft can suspend a lifted target in mid-air until the end of your next Turn; while suspended it cannot take movement actions and attacks against it have Advantage.  
* **Catching Wall:** Wind Wall also catches incoming ranged projectiles that miss, dropping them harmlessly; a creature that rolls a natural miss into the wall is also Slowed.  
* **Widening Gale:** Gale Force's cone extends to a 40-ft cone and its difficult-terrain scatter lasts until end of your next Turn.

#### Limitations

* **Open Air Required:** Air Control depends on room for the air to move. In a sealed, cramped, or fully enclosed space with no open air — a packed vault, a flooded chamber, the deep underground — Core Track drops by 1 tier and Tier 3 powers are unavailable until you reach open air. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **No Killing Edge:** Air Control's damage is concussive, never penetrating. It cannot reduce a target below 1 HP — the final blow that would drop a creature instead leaves it Stunned until end of its next Turn. A controller who wants a kill needs another source for it. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Vacuum Backlash:** Each time you use Vacuum Collapse or Living Cyclone, you take 1 Power Die bludgeoning damage as the pressure recoils through you. This cannot be reduced by Resistance or flat damage reduction. \+1 Power Pick.

### Animal Powers

| Governing Ability | Choose STR, DEX, or CON when you first acquire this Power Set |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Associated Conditions** | Prone, Restrained, Poisoned, Shaken |
| **Default Damage** | Power Dice × Core Track level \+ Governing Ability modifier \+ damage modifier (STR melee, DEX ranged, INT mental, CHA social) |
| **Ability Score Bonus** | None |

Animal Powers is the Power Set of the evolutionary library — the biological capabilities of the entire animal kingdom distilled into a single hero: striking speed, immense strength, echolocation, venom, armored hide, and predatory awareness all available to one body that has learned to access four billion years of biological development. Heroes may draw from genetic mutation, experimental enhancement, alien biology, mystical animal totems, or a connection to the primal force of animal life itself.

Animal Powers heroes are defined by biological versatility. They move between capabilities as the situation demands, and at higher tiers they can combine multiple animal capabilities simultaneously — becoming something that no single animal in nature has ever been.

#### Governing Ability

Choose **STR, DEX, or CON** when you first acquire this Power Set.

**STR** — animal capabilities expressed through predatory muscle, mass, leverage, and overwhelming physical force.

**DEX** — animal capabilities expressed through speed, reflexes, balance, coordination, and heightened sensory response.

**CON** — animal capabilities expressed through adaptation, resilience, venom, regeneration, environmental survival, and biological endurance.

#### Core Track

Animal Powers 1  
*Tier 1 Passive*

Choose two animal traits from the Tier 1 trait list (below). Each trait is always active unless suppressed. Natural weapons deal default damage track damage. Access to Tier 1 Combat Powers.

Animal Powers 2  
*Tier 2 Passive*

Choose two additional traits from Tier 1 or 2 lists. You may activate and suppress individual traits as a free action each round. Access to Tier 2 Combat Powers.

Animal Powers 3  
*Tier 3 Passive*

Choose two additional traits from any tier. Up to three traits active simultaneously. Combining complementary traits produces additional benefits (GM-defined): echolocation \+ pounce grants Advantage on the attack; venom \+ constriction deals additional venom damage per Turn. Access to Tier 3 Combat Powers.

Animal Powers 4  
*Tier 3 Apex Passive*

Choose two final traits from any tier. Once per day, enter **Apex Predator** for 1 minute. While active, all traits are simultaneously active at maximum expression, natural weapon attacks deal maximum damage on the dice, and you gain one Tier 3 trait of your choice for the duration even if not purchased.

#### Animal Trait Lists

#### Tier 1 Traits (available at Core Track 1\)

* **Claws:** Natural weapons deal slashing damage. Climb any clawable surface at full speed.  
* **Echolocation:** Blindsight within Close range (25 ft) through sound-based perception.  
* **Enhanced Smell:** Advantage on Notice checks by scent; track any creature by scent within 24 hours.  
* **Gecko Grip:** Climb any surface including ceilings at full speed; no Athletics check.  
* **Low Light Vision:** See in dim light as bright; in darkness as dim within Close range (25 ft).  
* **Pack Instinct:** Advantage on attack rolls against targets an ally attacked this Turn.  
* **Prehensile Tail:** A tail functioning as a third hand for grabbing and basic manipulation.  
* **Thick Hide:** Flat damage reduction equal to your Prowess against physical damage.  
* **Water Breathing:** Breathe underwater. Swim at full speed without penalty.

#### Tier 2 Traits (available at Core Track 2\)

* **Camouflage Skin:** Bonus Action to blend in. Advantage on Stealth; targets have Disadvantage on Notice while you are motionless.  
* **Constrictor Grip:** While grappling a target, they take 1 Power Die \+ Governing Ability modifier damage at the start of each of their Turns.  
* **Enhanced Reflexes:** Advantage on Initiative; cannot be surprised while conscious.  
* **Natural Armor:** Resistance to one physical damage type (choose when taken).  
* **Sonar Sense:** Blindsight within Short range (26–50 ft). Replaces or upgrades Echolocation.  
* **Venomous Strike:** On a natural weapon hit, apply venom as a free action. Roll Power Effect Value vs. CON Save or target gains Poisoned until end of their next Turn.  
* **Wall Crawl:** Climb any surface at full speed including ceilings. No Athletics checks to climb.

#### Tier 3 Traits (available at Core Track 3\)

* **Apex Predator Senses:** Full awareness of all creatures within Medium range (51–120 ft) regardless of darkness, invisibility, or concealment. Cannot be surprised.  
* **Armored Carapace:** Resistance to all physical damage types simultaneously.  
* **Bioluminescence:** Controlled light from Close dim to Short bright, or a disorienting attack (targets within Close range: WIS vs. Power Effect Value or Dazed until end of your next Turn).  
* **Regenerative Biology:** Regain HP equal to your Governing Ability modifier at the start of each Turn. Non-stacking — use only the highest passive per-Turn healing value.  
* **Tremorsense:** Detect precise location and movement of all creatures in contact with the same surface within Short range (26–50 ft) regardless of visibility.

#### Combat Powers

**Predatory Strike** — Tier 1 · At-Will · Action

*Prerequisite: Animal Powers 1*

A natural weapon attack combining the speed and precision of an apex predator. Claws, fangs, horns, a barbed tail — whatever your traits have given you, used the way the animal it came from would use it. No windup, no technique, just the part of you that is not entirely human doing what it does best.

* Range: Close (0–25 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ FIG \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Parry/Block  
* Hit: Default damage track (slashing, piercing, or bludgeoning)  
* Strong Success: Choose one based on active traits — knock Prone (strength traits); apply venom if you have Venomous Strike; Shaken until end of your next Turn (display traits); move up to Close range without provoking Reactions (agility traits)  
* Duration: Conditions until end of your next Turn

**Pounce** — Tier 1 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Animal Powers 1 · Must move at least Close range (25 ft) toward target first*

You launch yourself at a target with predatory speed, closing distance and striking in one fluid motion. The movement and the attack are a single act, so a target who thought they had room to react discovers they did not. Landing on top of someone tends to put them on the ground and keep them there.

* Range: Close (0–25 ft) after movement  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ FIG \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Parry/Block  
* Hit: Default damage track \+ 1 additional Power Die from momentum. Roll Power Effect Value vs. STR Save — Failure: knocked Prone; Success: Shaken until end of your next Turn  
* Duration: Prone until target stands

**Constrict** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Animal Powers 2 · Constrictor Grip trait*

You seize a target and begin crushing them with your full body weight. Once you have hold, the damage does not stop — every round they remain in your grip costs them more, and the longer it goes the worse their position becomes. Breaking free is the only thing that ends it.

* Range: Close (0–25 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ FIG \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Parry/Block  
* Hit: Target Grappled \+ 2 Power Dice crushing damage. While Grappled, takes 1 Power Die \+ Governing Ability modifier per Turn. Escape: STR vs. Power Effect Value as Action.  
* Duration: Until target escapes or you release

**Venom Burst** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Animal Powers 2 · Venomous Strike trait*

You deliver an overwhelming dose of venom through bite, sting, or spray. The initial hit is rarely what decides the fight; what decides it is a target who spends the next several rounds slowed, sickened, and steadily less able to defend themselves. Patience turns this into a kill.

* Range: Close (0–25 ft) contact · Short (26–50 ft) spray  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge (spray) or Parry/Block (contact)  
* Hit: 2 Power Dice poison damage. Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: Poisoned \+ Slowed until end of your next Turn; Success: Poisoned only  
* Duration: Until end of your next Turn

**Apex Strike** — Tier 3 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Animal Powers 3*

You combine multiple animal capabilities into a single overwhelming attack. Strength, venom, speed and grip all arrive at once rather than in sequence, and you choose which two of them land hardest. This is every trait you have paid for, spent together in one moment.

* Range: Close (0–25 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ FIG \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Parry/Block  
* Hit: 4 Power Dice damage. Choose up to two effects based on active traits applied simultaneously: Prone (strength), Poisoned (venom), Restrained (constriction), Blinded (bioluminescence), Slowed (crippling strike), or Shaken (intimidation display)  
* Duration: Conditions until end of your next Turn

**Pack Assault** — Tier 3 · Daily · Action

*Prerequisite: Animal Powers 3*

You coordinate with allies using instinctive predator pack tactics, directing a simultaneous strike that overwhelms a target's defenses. No words are needed and none are spoken — the timing is read rather than agreed. A target braced for one attacker is not braced for the whole pack arriving together.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft) · Affects you and up to your Governing Ability modifier in allies who can perceive you  
* Effect: You and each participating ally may immediately make one attack against the same target as a free action. Your attack deals 4 Power Dice \+ Governing Ability modifier on a hit; each ally uses normal attack and damage. The target has Disadvantage on all Active Defense rolls against these simultaneous attacks.

#### Set-Specific Utility Powers

**Animal Communication** — Tier 1 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Animal Powers 1*

Communicate simple ideas and emotions with animals of any type. Animals are naturally inclined toward you. Advantage on checks to calm, direct, or request assistance from animals. Replaces Animal Empathy General Utility if you have both.

**Biological Adaptation** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Animal Powers 2*

Over one minute, adapt your biology to one hostile environment (deep cold, extreme heat, high altitude, underwater pressure, or radiation). Immune to that environment's passive hazards for one scene. Only one active adaptation at a time.

**Predatory Tracking** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Animal Powers 2*

Track any creature you have directly perceived within the last 48 hours across any terrain using enhanced animal senses. Advantage on all checks to follow the trail. Weather, time, and deliberate evasion degrade but cannot automatically end the trail.

**Apex Senses** — Tier 3 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Animal Powers 3*

Detect living creatures by heartbeat and scent within Medium range (51–120 ft) through barriers. Identify individuals you have previously encountered by scent alone. Perceive structural weaknesses in buildings and objects by vibration sense. Always active; cannot be fully suppressed.

Enhancements

* **Rapid Trait Shift:** Activate and suppress traits as a free action at Core Track 1, rather than waiting until Core Track 2\.  
* **Enhanced Venom:** When Venomous Strike or Venom Burst applies Poisoned, the target also has Disadvantage on their first attack roll before end of their next Turn.  
* **Constriction Mastery:** While a target is Grappled through Constrict, you move at full speed rather than half speed.  
* **Pack Leader:** When you use Pack Assault, designate one ally whose attack automatically achieves Strong Success effects without requiring the margin.

Limitations

* **Instinct Override:** When Bloodied, GM may invoke this — roll 1d20 \+ WIS vs. 15 or revert to predatory instinct, prioritizing nearest perceived threat over tactical planning. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Obvious Biology:** Animal traits are never concealable. You cannot pass for an ordinary human without significant concealment. Social checks where appearance creates prejudice or fear suffer Disadvantage. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Environmental Dependency:** Traits are optimized for one environment (aquatic, forest, underground, arctic, etc.). Outside it, damage track drops by 1 Power Die and physical trait checks have Disadvantage. \+1 Power Pick.

### Armor Systems

| Governing Ability | Choose INT or STR when you first acquire this Power Set |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Associated Conditions** | Overloaded, Dazed, Prone, Blinded |
| **Default Damage** | Power Dice × Core Track level \+ Governing Ability modifier \+ damage modifier (STR melee, DEX ranged, INT mental, CHA social) |
| **Limitation Note** | Gear Dependent Limitation is very common for this Power Set |

Armor Systems is the Power Set of the powered suit. Not a costume — a weapons and defense platform built around the hero's body, representing years of engineering refinement, iterative improvement, and the genius of someone who decided the best way to be a hero was to build the capability rather than wait for it.

Armor Systems heroes are defined by versatility within a framework: flight, energy weapons, enhanced strength, sensor systems, and defensive plating all integrated into a single platform that can be upgraded and rebuilt between missions. The cost is dependency — without the suit, there are no powers.

#### Governing Ability

Choose **INT or STR** when you first acquire this Power Set.

**INT** — the engineer-pilot model: the hero understands, programs, modifies, and coordinates every system within the armour as an integrated technological platform.

**STR** — the warrior-pilot model: the armour functions as an extension of the hero's body, translating movement, leverage, aggression, and physical force through every weapon and defensive system.

#### Core Track

Armor Systems 1  
*Tier 1 Passive*

\+2 to all Active Defense rolls while armored. Resistance to one chosen damage type. Don armor in one minute (unless modified). Tier 1 access.

Armor Systems 2  
*Tier 2 Passive*

Active Defense bonus becomes \+3. Environmental sealing: no need to breathe, vacuum survival, immunity to airborne toxins and extreme temperature. Echolocation and Thermal Vision within Short range (26–50 ft). Tier 2 access.

Armor Systems 3  
*Tier 3 Passive*

Active Defense bonus becomes \+4. Once per encounter as a Reaction when you take damage, reduce that damage by 3 Power Dice \+ Governing Ability modifier. Bonus Action interface with compatible technological systems within Close range (25 ft). Tier 3 access.

Armor Systems 4  
*Tier 3 Apex Passive*

Once per day, enter **Full Combat Mode** for 1 minute: Active Defense bonus \+6; all attacks deal maximum damage; Emergency systems activate one spent Encounter Power as a free action once during duration; if reduced to 0 HP the suit automatically stabilizes you, moves you up to Short range from threat, and grants temporary HP equal to Governing Ability modifier \+ Prowess.

#### Combat Powers

**Blasters** — Tier 1 · At-Will · Action

*Prerequisite: Armor Systems 1 · Choose emission type from damage types list at character creation (permanent)*

A directed discharge from your suit's primary weapon system. Repulsors, particle beams, tuned plasma — the emission is whatever your build says it is, and it fires as readily as raising a hand. It is the shot you take when nothing more elaborate is called for, which is most of the time.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: Default damage track (chosen emission type)  
* Strong Success: Choose one: push target Short range (26–50 ft); knock Prone; Disadvantage on their next attack roll before end of their next Turn  
* Special: *Enhancement — Adaptive Emission:* Add up to 2 additional damage types. Declare emission type freely before each attack.

**Missile Salvo** — Tier 1 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Armor Systems 1*

Your suit fires guided munitions at up to three targets simultaneously. The targeting system does the work of splitting attention that a human gunner could not, tracking each one independently. Best spent on a spread-out formation rather than a single hard target — the damage per warhead is modest, but nobody hit stays standing comfortably.

* Range: Short area — up to three targets within Short range (26–50 ft) of each other  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of each target (same roll)  
* Hit: 1 Power Die \+ Governing Ability modifier damage per target. Power Effect Value vs. DEX Save or knocked Prone.  
* Duration: Prone until target stands

**System Disruption** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Armor Systems 2*

A targeted pulse designed to overload another technological system. Against a person in powered armour, a drone, or anything running on circuitry, it goes past the plating and attacks what is underneath. Against flesh and blood it still stings, but this is a weapon built for use on other machines.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: 2 Power Dice energy damage. Power Effect Value vs. INT — Failure: Overloaded \+ Power Disrupted until end of your next Turn (powered armor loses bonuses, tech powers unavailable); Success: Overloaded only. Against non-technological targets: damage only, no Overloaded/Power Disrupted.  
* Duration: Until end of your next Turn on failure

**Omnibeam** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Armor Systems 2*

Your suit's heavy weapon fires a concentrated sustained blast in a line. Everything standing in that line is caught, so a corridor, an alley, or a badly disciplined rank of enemies is exactly the shape it wants. Holding the beam takes the suit's full output while it runs.

* Range: Medium (51–120 ft) line through all creatures between you and target  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of each creature in the line  
* Hit: 3 Power Dice energy damage. Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: Dazed; Success: Shaken (both until end of your next Turn)  
* Special: *Enhancement — Adaptive Emission:* Same as Blasters.

**Tactical Barrage** — Tier 3 · Daily · Action

*Prerequisite: Armor Systems 3*

Your suit unleashes everything simultaneously in a coordinated full-system assault. Every weapon fires at once, every safety is off, and the dice come up maximum because nothing is being held back. The suit will need attention afterwards; whatever you pointed it at will need rather more.

* Range: Medium area (30-ft radius within 50–120 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of each creature in area  
* Hit: 6 Power Dice energy damage, maximum on all dice. Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: Stunned \+ knocked Prone; Success: Dazed only (both until end of your next Turn)

**Emergency Countermeasures** — Tier 3 · Encounter · Reaction

*Prerequisite: Armor Systems 3 · Trigger: You take damage while armored*

Your suit's emergency systems engage automatically. Reduce incoming damage by 3 Power Dice \+ Governing Ability modifier. If reduction brings damage to 0, the suit vents excess energy as a shockwave: each creature within Close range (25 ft) Power Effect Value vs. DEX — Failure: the target is pushed Close range and knocked Prone. This is distinct from the Core Track 3 Reaction — they do not share uses.

#### Set-Specific Utility Powers

**Suit Deployment** — Tier 1 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Armor Systems 1*

Don or deploy your armor as a Bonus Action. Define the deployment method at character creation (assembles from storage, launches remotely, deploys from compact form, etc.).

**Armor Flight** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Armor Systems 2*

Integrated flight. Flying speed equal to Short range per Turn (26–50 ft) in combat; sustained cruise for regional travel outside combat. If you also have the Flight Power Set, use the higher speed — these do not stack.

**Remote Operation** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Armor Systems 2*

Operate your suit remotely when not wearing it. The suit acts on your initiative, can move and use basic systems, provides a sensor feed. Uses your attack bonus; cannot use Daily powers remotely. The suit has HP equal to half your maximum and is destroyed if reduced to 0\.

**Modular Configuration** — Tier 3 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Armor Systems 3*

During a Breather, reconfigure for one mode until next Breather: **Assault Mode** — all Armor Systems attacks deal 1 additional Power Die. **Defense Mode** — Active Defense bonus \+1; Emergency Countermeasures reduces damage by 1 additional Power Die. **Support Mode** — produce one gadget effect per scene equivalent to a Tier 1 Gadgetry power (no Gadgetry Power Set required).

#### Enhancements

* **Reinforced Systems:** Resistance from Core Track 1 extends to a second damage type. Both active simultaneously while armored.  
* **Targeting Systems:** Once per encounter, declare Lock-On against one target as a free action. Until end of your next Turn, all Armor Systems attacks against them ignore Cover bonuses.  
* **Power Cells:** Emergency Countermeasures may be used twice per encounter before requiring a Breather to recharge.  
* **Integrated Support:** When Modular Configuration enters Support Mode, the gadget effect upgrades to Tier 2 Gadgetry equivalent rather than Tier 1\.

#### Limitations

* **Gear Dependent:** All powers require the suit. Without it: no Core Track benefits, no powers, no Active Defense bonus, no environmental protection. Recovery requires Downtime and resources. The defining Limitation of this archetype. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Power Dependency:** Suit requires a specific fuel source or recharge method. If unavailable, Core Track benefits drop one tier and Active Defense bonus halves until recharged. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Extended Deployment:** Suit takes 1 minute to don without Suit Deployment Utility. Being caught without the suit is a genuine tactical liability. \+1 Power Pick.

### Cold Control

| Governing Ability | Choose CON, WIS, or INT when you first acquire this Power Set |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Associated Conditions** | Frozen, Slowed, Restrained (via ice), Prone (via ice patches) |
| **Default Damage** | Power Dice × Core Track level \+ Governing Ability modifier \+ damage modifier (STR melee, DEX ranged, INT mental, CHA social) |
| **Tactical Role** | Battlefield control and terrain denial; ice as wall, floor, barrier, trap, and prison |

Cold Control is the Power Set of ice, frost, and absolute zero. The ability to drain thermal energy from the environment, from objects, and from living targets with precision that ranges from delicate crystalline frost to instant encasement in solid ice. Cold controllers are tacticians as much as fighters — ice is a wall, a floor, a barrier, a trap, and a prison simultaneously.

#### Governing Ability

Choose **CON, WIS, or INT** when you first acquire this Power Set.

**CON** — cold generated through altered biology, an internal thermal sink, or a body capable of producing and surviving extreme temperature loss.

**WIS** — intuitive or mystical attunement to winter, stillness, ice, and the absence of heat, directing cold through patience and inner control.

**INT** — calculated manipulation of thermal energy, molecular motion, pressure, and heat transfer through scientific precision.

#### Core Track

Cold Control 1  
*Tier 1 Passive*

Generate and project cold; create frost; chill objects and surfaces. Resistance to cold damage. Immune to extreme cold environments. Tier 1 access.

Cold Control 2  
*Tier 2 Passive*

Combat-scale ice formation and sustained freezing fields. Immunity to cold damage (replaces Resistance). Cold attacks ignore cold Resistance equal to your Prowess. Tier 2 access.

Cold Control 3  
*Tier 3 Passive*

Immunity to cold and extreme environmental cold of any natural origin. Cold attacks ignore cold Resistance entirely and treat cold Immunity as Resistance. Tier 3 access.

Cold Control 4  
*Tier 3 Apex Passive*

Once per day, enter **Absolute Zero State** for 1 minute: all cold attacks deal maximum damage; targets whose Save Value your power roll beats become Frozen rather than Slowed; immunity to all fire and heat damage.

#### Combat Powers

**Ice Shard** — Tier 1 · At-Will · Action

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 1*

Draw the water out of the air and drive it forward as a spike of ice. It arrives cold and sharp at once, so it cuts as well as it chills. There is no shortage of ammunition — anywhere there is air, there is another shard.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: Default damage track (cold and piercing)  
* Strong Success: Slowed until end of your next Turn

**Ice Patch** — Tier 1 · At-Will · Action

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 1*

Coat the ground in slick ice beneath targets. The footing goes out from under everyone in the area at once, and it stays gone — the patch remains until something melts it, so a doorway or a stairwell iced early keeps paying you back for the rest of the fight.

* Range: Close area (15-ft radius, 0–25 ft)  
* Effect: Area becomes difficult terrain until melted. Each creature in the area Power Effect Value vs. DEX — Failure: the target is knocked Prone. Difficult terrain persists until cleared.

**Cold Aura** — Tier 1 · Encounter · Bonus Action

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 1*

Radiate intense cold. Until start of your next Turn, any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes cold damage equal to your Prowess and loses 10 feet of Speed until end of their next Turn.

**Flash Freeze** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 2*

Pull every degree of heat out of one target between one breath and the next. Moisture on skin and clothing becomes rime, joints lock, and a body that was moving a moment ago simply stops. Done properly it takes someone out of the fight entirely without a mark on them.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: 2 Power Dice cold damage. Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: Frozen; Success: Slowed (both until end of your next Turn)

**Cold Snap** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 2*

Drop the temperature across an area sharply enough that everyone in it starts to seize up. Nobody is frozen solid, but muscles stiffen, reactions lag and everything takes longer than it should. Use it on a group that is about to close on you and watch them arrive late and slow.

* Range: Short area (20-ft radius within 26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of each creature  
* Hit: 2 Power Dice cold damage. Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: Speed halved \+ Slowed; Success: Speed halved only (until end of your next Turn)

**Freeze the Room** — Tier 3 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 3*

Take the heat out of an entire space rather than a person. Windows frost, water goes solid, and every creature in the area slows to whatever pace the cold will allow. This is a power for changing the terms of a fight rather than winning it outright — afterwards the room belongs to you.

* Range: Medium area (30-ft radius within 50–120 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of each enemy  
* Hit: 3 Power Dice cold damage. Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: Slowed; Success: Speed reduced 10 ft (until end of your next Turn). Entire area becomes difficult terrain from ice and frost until end of your next Turn.

**Absolute Zero** — Tier 3 · Daily · Action

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 3*

Take the temperature of a place as close to nothing as physics allows, once a day. Matter behaves strangely at the bottom of the scale: things become brittle that should not, and a living body caught in it stops rather than slows. What you freeze here does not thaw quickly.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: 6 Power Dice cold damage, maximum on all dice. Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: Frozen until end of your next Turn \+ Slowed for the remainder of the encounter; Success: Frozen until end of your next Turn only

#### Set-Specific Utility Powers

**Chill Object** — Tier 1 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 1*

Freeze, chill, or frost any unattended object as an Action. Extinguish small fires, preserve biological samples, freeze locks solid, make surfaces dangerously slippery, weld objects with ice. Effect is permanent until heat is applied.

**Preserve** — Tier 1 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 1*

Maintain a perfect preservation field around biological material. Material does not decay, decompose, or deteriorate. A dying creature in preservation stasis does not make saves but also does not improve — field paramedic and crime scene tool.

**Ice Slide** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 2*

Create an ice ramp, bridge, or slide between two points within Medium range (51–120 ft). Supports your weight plus up to Governing Ability modifier additional passengers. Moving along your ice structure costs no additional movement and grants \+10 ft speed. Persists for one scene or until melted.

**Ice Wall** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 2*

As an Action, create an ice wall up to 30 ft long, 10 ft high, 1 ft thick within Short range (26–50 ft). HP equal to 5 × your Level; Resistance to all damage except fire. Creatures can break through with STR vs. your Power Effect Value. Persists until destroyed or melted.

**Cryo-Shell** — Tier 3 · Utility · Reaction

*Prerequisite: Cold Control 3 · Trigger: You or one ally within Close range (25 ft) would take damage*

Encase the target in a protective ice shell. They reduce incoming damage by 3 Power Dice but become Restrained until start of their next Turn. Break free early: STR vs. Power Effect Value as Action.

#### Enhancements

* **Extended Freeze:** Flash Freeze's Frozen duration extends to end of the target's next Turn rather than yours.  
* **Layered Ice:** When Ice Patch knocks a target Prone, they are also Slowed until end of your next Turn.  
* **Cold Mastery:** Cold Aura damage increases to Prowess \+ Governing Ability modifier.  
* **Blizzard Field:** Freeze the Room's difficult terrain lasts until end of your Turn after next (two rounds of persistence).

#### Limitations

* **Heat Vulnerability:** Fire, heat, and radiant damage bypass flat damage reduction if you have it. Disadvantage on saves against fire and heat. Powers suppressed for one Turn after taking fire damage exceeding your CON. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Obvious Manifestation:** Frost forms nearby when you concentrate; breath always visible; attacks create unmistakable ice formations. Stealth while using Cold Control is impossible. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Environmental Dependency:** In extremely hot environments, Power Effect Value −3 and cold attacks deal 1 fewer Power Die. \+1 Power Pick.

### Cosmic Power

| Governing Ability | Choose CHA or WIS when you first acquire this Power Set |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Associated Conditions** | Dazed, Stunned, Blinded (cosmic radiance), Prone (force) |
| **Default Damage** | Power Dice × Core Track level \+ Governing Ability modifier \+ damage modifier (STR melee, DEX ranged, INT mental, CHA social) |
| **Tactical Role** | Versatile offense \+ defense; Power Negation; cosmic-scale mobility |

Cosmic Power is the Power Set of heroes touched by forces operating beyond human comprehension — contact with something that exists outside the normal boundaries of what a person can be. They project raw cosmic energy expressible as any force, move through space naturally, and at the highest tiers interact with reality itself: negating powers, anchoring dimensions.

#### Governing Ability

Choose **CHA or WIS** when you first acquire this Power Set.

**CHA** — cosmic power expressed through the hero's identity and sheer force of being; they do not merely channel the power but embody its presence.

**WIS** — spiritual, perceptual, or philosophical attunement to cosmic forces, allowing the hero to channel them through understanding, balance, and awareness of the universe beyond themselves.

#### Core Track

Cosmic Power 1  
*Tier 1 Passive*

Resistance to radiant damage. Does not need to breathe; survives vacuum indefinitely. Emits faint suppressable luminescence. Tier 1 access.

Cosmic Power 2  
*Tier 2 Passive*

Immunity to radiant damage (replaces Resistance). Perceive cosmic energy signatures within Medium range (51–120 ft). Tier 2 access.

Cosmic Power 3  
*Tier 3 Passive*

Cosmic attacks ignore Resistance to radiant; treat Immunity as Resistance. Once per encounter when dealing damage with a Cosmic Power attack, add 1 Power Die as a free action. Tier 3 access.

Cosmic Power 4  
*Tier 3 Apex Passive*

Once per day, enter **Full Cosmic Manifestation** for 1 minute: immunity to all damage from non-superpowered sources; movement does not provoke Reactions; all attacks deal maximum damage on the dice; once per round negate one Power, effect, or condition affecting yourself or one ally within Short range (26–50 ft) as a free action.

#### Combat Powers

**Cosmic Bolt** — Tier 1 · At-Will · Action

*Prerequisite: Cosmic Power 1*

A lance of hard starlight thrown from an open hand. It is the plainest expression of what you are carrying — no shaping, no ritual, just raw cosmic energy pointed at something. Bright enough that a solid hit can leave the target seeing nothing at all.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: Default damage track (Radiant). Strong Success: push Short range (26–50 ft), knock Prone, or Blind until end of your next Turn.

**Cosmic Shield** — Tier 1 · Encounter · Reaction

*Prerequisite: Cosmic Power 1 · Trigger: You or one ally within Short range (26–50 ft) would take damage*

Project a cosmic energy field. Reduce damage by 2 Power Dice \+ Governing Ability modifier. If this brings damage to 0, the attacker is pushed Close range (25 ft) from the protected target.

**Energy Absorption** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Reaction

*Prerequisite: Cosmic Power 2 · Trigger: You take energy damage of any type*

Absorb incoming energy. Reduce damage by 3 Power Dice \+ Governing Ability modifier. If reduction brings damage to 0, your next attack, before end of your next Turn. adds 2 Power Dice to its damage as you release the absorbed energy..

**Stellar Flare** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Cosmic Power 2*

Release a sudden bloom of light and radiation the way a star does, without warning and in every direction. Anyone looking at you when it happens is looking at nothing afterwards. Useful precisely when you are outnumbered and being watched by all of them at once.

* Range: Short area (20-ft radius within 26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of each creature  
* Hit: 2 Power Dice radiant damage. Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: Blinded; Success: Shaken (both until end of your next Turn)

**Power Negation** — Tier 3 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Cosmic Power 3*

Temporarily sever a target's connection to their power source. Whatever they draw on — a reactor, a bloodline, a bargain, a star — you reach past the person and close the tap. For a few moments they are whoever they were before they got their powers, which is often the more frightening question for them.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ INT \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Willpower  
* Hit: Power Effect Value vs. target's Governing Ability — Failure: one chosen Power Set Power Disrupted until end of your next Turn (passive benefits suppressed, powers unavailable, Sustained Powers end); Success: Overloaded only

**Stellar Collapse** — Tier 3 · Daily · Action

*Prerequisite: Cosmic Power 3*

Gather everything you are holding into a single point and let it fall in on itself, once a day. For an instant there is a star where your target was standing, and then there is not. Nothing about this is subtle and nothing about it is repeatable in the same fight.

* Range: Medium area (40-ft radius within 50–120 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of each creature  
* Hit: 6 Power Dice radiant damage, maximum on all dice. Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: Stunned until end of your next Turn \+ pushed Short range (26–50 ft) from center; Success: Dazed until end of your next Turn \+ pushed Close range (25 ft) only

#### Set-Specific Utility Powers

**Cosmic Flight** — Tier 1 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Cosmic Power 1*

Flying speed equal to Short range per Turn (26–50 ft) in combat. Outside combat, can reach orbital velocity and travel between planets in the same solar system. If you also have Flight, use the higher speed — these do not stack.

**Void Step** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Cosmic Power 2*

As an Action, step through dimensional space and emerge anywhere within Medium range (51–120 ft) you can perceive or have visited. May bring one willing creature. Does not provoke Reactions. Passenger: WIS vs. Power Effect Value or Shaken until end of their next Turn.

**Cosmic Sense** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Cosmic Power 2*

Sense general location and power level of any being with significant superhuman capabilities within Long range (121–300 ft). Automatically detect dimensional anomalies, active Power Negation fields, and cosmic-scale threats within the same range. Know the direction of the nearest dimensional rift within one mile.

**Reality Anchor** — Tier 3 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Cosmic Power 3*

As an Action, stabilize the local dimensional fabric within Short range (26–50 ft) for one scene. Teleportation fails unless superpowered and the user's WIS Save Value meets or beats your Power Effect Value roll. Dimensional movement suppressed. Reality-warping effects in the area have Disadvantage on attacks or DCs increase by your Prowess. Does not affect your own powers.

**Universal Translation** — Tier 3 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Cosmic Power 3*

Understand and speak any language — alien languages, dimensional languages, mathematical constructs, basic emotional broadcasts of non-verbal beings. Passive and always active; no concentration required.

#### Enhancements

* **Extended Negation:** Power Negation's Power Disrupted duration extends to end of the target's next Turn.  
* **Cosmic Radiance:** Passive luminescence can be activated as a Bonus Action to fill Close range with bright light and Short range with dim light. Radiance-sensitive creatures have Disadvantage on attacks against you while active.  
* **Absorption Mastery:** When Energy Absorption reduces damage to 0, immediately move up to Close range (25 ft) without provoking Reactions.  
* **Stellar Shield:** Cosmic Shield also applies to the next attack against the protected target before the start of your next Turn.

#### Limitations

* **Cosmic Responsibility:** Once per session GM may present a cosmic-level situation demanding your attention, potentially conflicting with the current mission. Ignoring it may have campaign consequences. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Power Dependency:** Cosmic power requires an ongoing connection to its source. If disrupted by a specific event, Core Track drops by 1 tier until restored. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Obvious Manifestation:** You glow, trail cosmic light, and are immediately identifiable when powers are active. Stealth while using Cosmic Power is impossible. \+1 Power Pick.

### Earth Control

| Governing Ability | Choose STR, CON, or WIS when you first acquire this Power Set |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Associated Conditions** | Prone (via tremor and upheaval), Restrained (via entombment), Grappled (via stone grip), Slowed (via rubble and broken terrain) |
| **Default Damage** | Power Dice × Core Track level \+ Governing Ability modifier \+ damage modifier (STR melee, DEX ranged, INT mental, CHA social) |
| **Tactical Role** | Heavy offense and battlefield disruption; armored bulwark; crushing single-target and area control |

Earth Control is the Power Set of stone, seismic force, and the mineral bones of the world. The ability to crack open the ground at will, hurl boulders with the force of a wrecking ball, harden flesh into living rock, and bring an entire battlefield down around an enemy's feet. Earth controllers hit like nothing else in the game — sluggers and bulwarks in equal measure, armored in stone when they need to take a hit, devastating when they need to give one. They do not need finesse. The ground itself does the work.

#### Governing Ability

Choose **STR, CON, or WIS** when you first acquire this Power Set.

**STR** — stone and seismic force directed through raw physical power, impact, leverage, and the instinct to move the world by force.

**CON** — an endurance-based connection to the earth, the hero's body functioning as an extension of bedrock: stable, tireless, and extraordinarily difficult to move.

**WIS** — deep, patient attunement to stone, soil, fault lines, and the ancient structure of the world beneath the hero's feet.

#### Core Track

Earth Control 1  
*Tier 1 Passive*

Shape, fracture, and command earth, stone, and unworked rock within range; harden your own skin to a stony texture at will. Resistance to bludgeoning damage. Tier 1 access.

Earth Control 2  
*Tier 2 Passive*

Combat-scale stone shaping and durable hardened skin. Immunity to bludgeoning damage (replaces Resistance). Tremorsense — sense vibrations and movement through solid ground within Short range (26–50 ft) without a check. Tier 2 access.

Earth Control 3  
*Tier 3 Passive*

Earth attacks ignore bludgeoning Resistance entirely and treat bludgeoning Immunity as Resistance. Once per encounter as a free action, cause the ground within Short range (26–50 ft) to become difficult terrain for everyone but yourself. Tier 3 access.

Earth Control 4  
*Tier 3 Apex Passive*

Once per day, enter **Living Bedrock** for 1 minute: immunity to all physical damage from non-superpowered sources; cannot be knocked Prone or moved against your will; all earth attacks deal maximum damage on the dice.

#### Combat Powers

**Rock Lance** — Tier 1 · At-Will · Action

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 1*

Drive a spar of stone out of the ground, a wall, or the air in front of you and send it downrange like a ballista bolt. Almost everything else in this set happens underfoot — this is the one that reaches. Open with it when the fight starts at distance, because a Strong Success puts the target on the ground before they ever close on you.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: Default damage track (piercing). Strong Success: knocked Prone.

**Stone Fist** — Tier 1 · At-Will · Action

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 1*

Sheathe your hand and forearm in a slab of rock and hit someone with it. No setup, no resource, nothing clever — just weight arriving fast, and on a Strong Success the target leaves at speed. Use it to clear space as much as to deal damage; an enemy shoved twenty-five feet has to spend their entire next Turn walking back to you.

* Range: Close (0–25 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ FIG \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Parry/Block  
* Hit: Default damage track (bludgeoning). Strong Success: push Close range (25 ft) from you.

**Stoneskin Surge** — Tier 1 · Encounter · Bonus Action

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 1*

Harden your entire body to dense, armored stone. Until start of your next Turn, gain \+2 Active Defense and Resistance to slashing and piercing damage in addition to any Resistance you already have.

**Tremor** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 2*

Slam a shockwave through the ground and let the footing do the work. Everyone in the radius takes the hit, and the ones who fail go down — which matters more than the damage, because melee attacks against a Prone target land at Advantage. This is what you open a crowd fight with: one Action, and the whole front rank is on its back for your allies.

* Range: Short area (20-ft radius within 26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of each creature  
* Hit: 2 Power Dice bludgeoning damage. Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: knocked Prone; Success: Slowed only (both until end of your next Turn).

**Stone Grip** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 2*

Reach into the ground beneath one enemy and let it close around their legs. Stone flows up over boots and ankles and then sets, and a Grappled target has a Speed of zero — no retreat, no repositioning, no walking away from whichever of your allies wants them next. This is your answer to anything fast that would rather be somewhere else.

Target must be standing on a surface connected to solid ground.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: 2 Power Dice bludgeoning damage. Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: Grappled; Success: Slowed only (both until end of your next Turn).

**Seismic Rupture** — Tier 3 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 3*

Open a fault line across the far side of the battlefield. The ground heaves and splits, throwing everyone inside the radius outward and down, and what it leaves behind is a field of rubble and fissures that costs everyone else movement to cross. Reach for it when the opposition has formed up — it scatters the formation and then makes re-forming expensive.

* Range: Medium area (30-ft radius within 50–120 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of each creature  
* Hit: 3 Power Dice bludgeoning damage. Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: knocked Prone \+ pushed Close range (25 ft) from the center; Success: pushed Close range only. Area becomes difficult terrain from rubble and fissures until end of your next Turn.

**Cataclysm** — Tier 3 · Daily · Action

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 3*

Bring the ground up around one target and close it over them. This is the largest thing Earth Control does to a single person — maximum damage on all six dice, and whoever is still standing afterward comes out of the rubble Slowed for the rest of the encounter. Save it for the one enemy the encounter is actually about.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: 6 Power Dice bludgeoning damage, maximum on all dice. Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: Restrained until end of your next Turn \+ Slowed for the remainder of the encounter; Success: Restrained until end of your next Turn only.

**Bulwark Stance** — Tier 3 · Encounter · Reaction

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 3 · Trigger: You or one ally within Close range (25 ft) would take physical damage*

Raise a wall of stone from the ground to intercept the blow. Reduce incoming damage by 3 Power Dice \+ Governing Ability modifier. If this brings damage to 0, the stone remains as a barrier providing Cover (+5 Active Defense) until start of your next Turn.

#### Set-Specific Utility Powers

**Shape Stone** — Tier 1 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 1*

Shape any earth or stone you control into simple stationary forms: a ramp, a wall section, a set of stairs, or a platform. Holds until dismissed or destroyed. Cannot be shaped into a weapon or used to deal damage.

**Mineral Sense** — Tier 1 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 1*

Sense the composition, density, and structural integrity of any stone, soil, or mineral within Short range (26–50 ft), including hollow spaces, unstable structures, buried objects, and ore deposits. Purely informational; no check required.

**Earthen Climb** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 2*

Reshape stone and earth surfaces into handholds and footholds as you move. Climbing Speed equal to full Speed on any stone, earth, or masonry surface, even sheer angles, with no check required.

**Tunnel** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 2*

As an Action, carve a stable tunnel through earth or unworked stone at Short range (26–50 ft) per minute. Tunnel does not collapse on its own; wide enough for you and one ally walking abreast. Not fast enough for combat use.

**Structural Reinforcement** — Tier 3 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Earth Control 3*

As an Action, stabilize and reinforce a damaged or collapsing structure within Short range (26–50 ft), preventing further collapse for one scene. Reinforced structure has HP equal to 5 × your Level against further structural damage.

#### Enhancements

* **Extended Grip:** Stone Grip's Grappled duration extends to end of the target's next Turn rather than yours.  
* **Crushing Tremor:** Targets knocked Prone by Tremor take 1 additional Power Die bludgeoning damage from falling debris.  
* **Piercing Lance:** Rock Lance's Strong Success push may instead deal 1 additional Power Die of damage, chosen at the time of attack.  
* **Lasting Rupture:** Seismic Rupture's difficult terrain lasts until end of your Turn after next (two rounds of persistence).

#### Limitations

* **Surface Dependent:** Requires a connection to natural earth, stone, or unworked mineral within range to function at full strength. On a fully artificial surface with no exposed ground beneath it (upper floors, a ship's deck, open water), Core Track drops by 1 tier and Tier 3 Earth Control powers are unavailable until a connected surface is reached. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Obvious Manifestation:** The ground audibly shifts and cracks around you when you concentrate; hardened skin is visibly stone-textured while active; attacks leave unmistakable structural damage. Stealth while using Earth Control is impossible. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Slow and Heavy:** Base Speed reduced by 10 ft. Disadvantage on DEX Saves against effects that would knock you Prone or move you against your will, except while Stoneskin Surge or Living Bedrock is active. \+1 Power Pick.

### Elasticity

| Governing Ability | CON (fixed) — all attack rolls, Effect Values, and Power Effect Values |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Associated Conditions** | Restrained (wrap/constriction), Prone (sweep/trip), Grappled (extended limb), Dazed (unexpected angle impact) |
| **Default Damage** | Power Dice × Core Track level \+ CON modifier \+ damage modifier (STR melee, DEX ranged, INT mental, CHA social) |
| **Tactical Role** | Reach, multi-target melee, living restraint; attack from unexpected angles and distances |

Elasticity is the Power Set of a body that has become something other than solid — a body whose fundamental material properties have changed so that it stretches, compresses, flows, and reforms with complete voluntary control. Elasticity heroes are defined by geometric creativity and spatial unpredictability: they attack from angles melee heroes cannot reach, restrain opponents by becoming the restraint, and escape any physical containment.

#### Core Track

Elasticity 1  
*Tier 1 Passive*

Extend any limb or body part up to Short range (26–50 ft); compress to fit through any opening at least 6 inches in diameter. Natural melee reach extends to Close range (25 ft). Resistance to bludgeoning damage. Tier 1 access.

Elasticity 2  
*Tier 2 Passive*

Extend limbs up to Medium range (51–120 ft); compress to 1-inch openings. Bludgeoning Resistance becomes Immunity; Resistance to piercing damage. Tier 2 access.

Elasticity 3  
*Tier 3 Passive*

Extend limbs up to Long range (121–300 ft); compress to molecular thinness. Piercing Resistance becomes Immunity; Resistance to slashing damage. Once per encounter when you take physical damage, reduce it by Prowess \+ CON as a free action. Tier 3 access.

Elasticity 4  
*Tier 3 Apex Passive*

Once per day, enter **Fluid Form** for 1 minute: immunity to all physical damage from non-superpowered sources; extension range Extreme (300+ ft); extend multiple limbs simultaneously without action cost; any creature attempting to grapple, restrain, or strike you in melee automatically fails unless their attack roll achieves a Strong Success.

#### Combat Powers

**Elastic Strike** — Tier 1 · At-Will · Action

*Prerequisite: Elasticity 1*

Throw a punch from fifty feet away. The arm travels, the fist arrives, and because it came around a corner or up from the floor rather than straight down the line, a Strong Success leaves the target Dazed — down to a single Action on their next Turn and no Reactions at all. This is a melee attack with a sniper's reach: stand where nothing can reach you and hit anyway.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ FIG \+ CON \+ Prowess vs. Parry/Block  
* Hit: Default damage track (bludgeoning). Strong Success: Dazed until end of your next Turn from impact at unexpected angle.

**Elastic Sweep** — Tier 1 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Elasticity 1*

Extend a leg or an arm to its full length and take it through everything standing in front of you in one motion. Up to three targets go over on the same attack roll, which makes this the cheapest crowd control the set owns. Reach for it the moment more than two enemies line up on you — three opponents picking themselves up off the floor is most of a round their side does not get to use.

* Range: Close area (15-ft arc within 0–25 ft, up to three targets)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ FIG \+ CON \+ Prowess vs. Parry/Block of each target (same roll)  
* Hit: 1 Power Die \+ CON modifier bludgeoning per target. Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: knocked Prone; Success: pushed Close range in direction of sweep

**Constricting Wrap** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Elasticity 2*

Wrap yourself around one target and start closing. This is not a hold anybody talks their way out of — the target is Restrained, losing Power Dice every Turn, and has to spend a whole Action on a Strength check simply to get loose. Pick the enemy your party least wants moving and become the reason they are not.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ FIG \+ CON \+ Prowess vs. Parry/Block  
* Hit: Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: Restrained until end of your next Turn; takes 1 Power Die \+ CON modifier per Turn; escape as Action (STR vs. Power Effect Value). Success: Grappled only.

**Spring Launch** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Elasticity 2*

Compress to maximum density then release explosively. You become a loaded spring and then a projectile, crossing the gap as a single blur with your whole mass arriving behind the strike. Reach for it when the one you want is on the far side of a room full of people who would otherwise get a free swing at you on the way past. Move up to Short range (26–50 ft) in a straight line without provoking Reactions; attack at end.

* Attack: 1d20 \+ FIG \+ CON \+ Prowess vs. Parry/Block  
* Hit: 3 Power Dice \+ CON modifier bludgeoning. Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: Prone \+ pushed Short range; Success: Prone only

**Elastic Cage** — Tier 3 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Elasticity 3*

Spread into a lattice of limbs and close it around an entire cluster of enemies at once. Everyone caught is Restrained inside the cage, taking damage each Turn and unable to get more than twenty-five feet from you — and you move at half speed for as long as you hold it. It is the closest thing in the game to bringing your own prison to the fight.

* Range: Close area (15-ft radius within 0–25 ft), up to CON modifier in targets  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ FIG \+ CON \+ Prowess vs. Parry/Block of each target  
* Hit: Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: Restrained until end of your next Turn; cannot move beyond Close range of you; 1 Power Die bludgeoning damage per Turn. You move at half speed while maintaining. Success: Slowed only.

**Impact Slam** — Tier 3 · Daily · Action

*Prerequisite: Elasticity 3*

Compress your whole body to its densest state and release it down a straight line as a single travelling wall of mass. Maximum damage on all six dice to everything standing in a hundred-and-twenty-foot lane, and whoever fails comes out of it Stunned. This is the once-a-day answer to a corridor, a bridge, or a line of enemies that made the mistake of forming up neatly.

* Range: Medium (51–120 ft) line, all creatures in the line  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ FIG \+ CON \+ Prowess vs. Parry/Block of each creature  
* Hit: 6 Power Dice bludgeoning damage, maximum on all dice. Power Effect Value vs. STR — Failure: Stunned until end of your next Turn \+ pushed Short range; Success: Dazed only

#### Set-Specific Utility Powers

**Compression** — Tier 1 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Elasticity 1*

Compress to fit through any opening at least 6 inches in diameter, flatten to slide under doors, reshape to fit into containers that should not hold a person. Extensive infiltration, investigation, and escape applications. Can hold this state indefinitely.

**Extended Reach** — Tier 1 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Elasticity 1*

Extend any limb or body part to perform fine manipulation at Short range (26–50 ft): picking locks across a room, pressing buttons on the far side of a barrier, retrieving objects from inaccessible locations. Precise enough for delicate work.

**Impact Absorption** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Elasticity 2*

Take no falling damage regardless of height. Spread and flow to distribute impact across your entire surface area. Use yourself as a landing pad for falling allies. Catch projectiles and thrown objects with Advantage on the relevant check.

**Elastic Flight** — Tier 2 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Elasticity 2*

Gliding membrane or elastic propulsion grants flying speed equal to Close range per Turn (25 ft); can hover. Slowest flight in the game — cannot be upgraded by Enhancements. Does not stack with Flight Power Set.

**Shapeshifting Disguise** — Tier 3 · Utility

*Prerequisite: Elasticity 3*

Reshape facial features, body proportions, skin texture, and superficial appearance to mimic another humanoid's looks. Visual approximation rather than biological duplicate. Casual observers cannot distinguish you from the original. Creatures who know the original well gain Advantage on Insight checks to detect the deception.

#### Enhancements

* **Extended Wrap:** Constricting Wrap's range increases to Medium (51–120 ft); maintain constriction at full speed rather than half.  
* **Snap-Back Strike:** Once per encounter when a melee attack misses you, immediately make one Elastic Strike as a Reaction at Advantage.  
* **Coiled Power:** When you use Spring Launch, add 1 Power Die per Zone traveled in a straight line before the attack (maximum \+2 dice).  
* **Elastic Shield:** Once per encounter as a Reaction when you or one ally within Close range (25 ft) would take physical damage, interpose your elastic body. Reduce that damage by 2 Power Dice \+ CON.

#### Limitations

* **Energy Vulnerability:** No protection against energy damage. No Resistance to fire, cold, lightning, radiant, or similar types. Enemies who cannot penetrate physical defenses may switch specifically to energy attacks. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Concentration Required:** When Stunned or Dazed, all Elasticity Sustained Powers end immediately and melee reach reverts to adjacent until the condition ends. \+1 Power Pick.  
* **Slow Reform:** After taking fire, cold, or energy damage exceeding CON in a single hit, extension range drops one range band and Encounter Powers are unavailable until start of your next Turn. \+1 Power Pick.

### Electricity Control

| Governing Ability | Choose CON, INT, or CHA when you first acquire this Power Set |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Associated Conditions** | Dazed, Stunned, Overloaded (against technological targets) |
| **Default Damage** | Power Dice × Core Track level \+ Governing Ability modifier \+ damage modifier (STR melee, DEX ranged, INT mental, CHA social) |
| **Tactical Role** | Disruptor; uniquely effective against technological opponents and powered armor |

Electricity Control is the Power Set of lightning, bio-electricity, electromagnetic pulse, and machine overload. Electricity controllers are uniquely effective against technological opponents — a villain in powered armor is a liability against a hero who can overload their systems with a touch. The conditions they inflict (Dazed, Stunned, Overloaded) compromise the target's action economy in ways that benefit the entire team.

#### Governing Ability

Choose **CON, INT, or CHA** when you first acquire this Power Set.

**CON** — electricity generated biologically through altered nerves, specialised organs, metabolism, or an internal bioelectric charge.

**INT** — precise control of current, voltage, circuits, electromagnetic effects, and technological systems through engineering and calculation.

**CHA** — electrical power projected through emotion, confidence, and force of personality, lightning becoming the visible expression of the hero's personal intensity.

#### Core Track

Electricity Control 1  
*Tier 1 Passive*

Generate and project electrical current. Resistance to lightning damage. Immune to non-superpowered electrical sources. Tier 1 access.

Electricity Control 2  
*Tier 2 Passive*

Immunity to lightning damage (replaces Resistance). Sense presence of active electrical systems, powered devices, and electromagnetic fields within Short range (26–50 ft) without a check. Tier 2 access.

Electricity Control 3  
*Tier 3 Passive*

Lightning attacks ignore Resistance entirely; treat Immunity as Resistance. Once per encounter when you deal lightning damage, arc to one additional target within Close range (25 ft) of the original for half damage — no additional attack roll. Tier 3 access.

Electricity Control 4  
*Tier 3 Apex Passive*

Once per day, enter **Living Lightning** for 1 minute: become partially electromagnetic — immunity to all physical damage from non-superpowered sources; movement does not provoke Reactions; all lightning attacks automatically chain to one additional target within Close range (25 ft) for full damage (not half).

#### Combat Powers

**Lightning Bolt** — Tier 1 · At-Will · Action

*Prerequisite: Electricity Control 1*

Throw a bolt from your hand, your eyes, or the air between you and the target. It is the fastest thing this set does and the one you will reach for most nights — nothing to charge, nothing to spend, and a Strong Success leaves the target Shaken and fumbling whatever they try next. When in doubt, this is the button.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge  
* Hit: Default damage track (lightning). Strong Success: Shaken until end of target's next Turn.

**Static Discharge** — Tier 1 · Encounter · Reaction

*Prerequisite: Electricity Control 1 · Trigger: A creature hits you with a melee attack*

The attacker takes lightning damage equal to Prowess \+ Governing Ability modifier and Power Effect Value vs. CON — Failure: Dazed until end of their next Turn. Success: Shaken. Fires automatically when a melee hit connects.

**Chain Lightning** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Electricity Control 2*

Put a bolt into one enemy and let it decide where to go after that. The arc jumps body to body across the room, as many targets as your Prowess allows, dealing less to each but Dazing anything that fails to shrug it off. This is what a group of enemies standing too close together is for.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft) primary; chain reaches each subsequent target within Close range (25 ft) of the previous  
* Attack: 1d20 \+ DEX \+ Governing Ability \+ Prowess vs. Dodge of primary (same roll for chain targets)  
* Hit (primary): 2 Power Dice \+ Governing Ability modifier lightning. **Hit (each chain):** 1 Power Die lightning. Power Effect Value vs. CON or Dazed until end of your next Turn. Maximum chain targets: equal to Prowess.

**System Overload** — Tier 2 · Encounter · Action

*Prerequisite: Electricity Control 2*

Target the electrical systems of a powered suit, vehicle, drone, or technological device directly. Rather than hitting the person, you hit the thing that makes them dangerous — a failure leaves it Overloaded and Power Disrupted, and the armoured villain is abruptly just a person wearing something very heavy. Against anything without circuitry it is a plain damage attack, so hold it for the fights where the opposition brought hardware.

* Range: Short (26–50 ft)
